enemies.name: Entry-Level Slime
enemies.flavor: Fresh out of slime school. Very motivated. Zero skills.

enemies.name: Spicy Slime
enemies.flavor: Ate one (1) pepper and never recovered emotionally.

enemies.name: Damp Slime
enemies.flavor: Distantly related to Suspicious Puddle. They don't talk about it.

enemies.name: Meadow Wolf (Probationary)
enemies.flavor: Still in his 90-day trial period with the pack. Trying very hard.

actions.name: Practice Howl
actions.desc: A big hit. He's been rehearsing.

enemies.name: Non-Union Bee Swarm
enemies.flavor: Beatrice Bumble has strong opinions about these scabs.

enemies.name: Passive-Aggressive Mushroom
enemies.flavor: 'No no, it's FINE. Step on me. Everyone else does.'

enemies.name: Clipboard Goblin
enemies.flavor: Nobody hired him. Nobody can fire him. He has a clipboard.

enemies.name: Deceptively Fast Snail
enemies.flavor: Slow countdown. HUGE hit. Do the math before it does.

actions.name: Sudden Zoom
actions.desc: It was never slow. It was waiting.

enemies.name: HR Butterfly
enemies.flavor: Fluttering by to remind you this battle violates workplace policy.

actions.name: Schedule a Meeting
actions.desc: Reduces your move time. The meeting could have been an email.

actions.name: Wing Slap
actions.desc: Gentle but firm, like her feedback.

enemies.name: Slime Supervisor Dave
enemies.flavor: Wears a tie ON his slime. Middle management made flesh. Well, made goo.

actions.name: Performance Review
actions.desc: Locks 4 orbs. 'We need to talk about your output.'

actions.name: Synergy Ooze
actions.desc: Converts 3 orbs to Nature. Leveraging core competencies.

enemies.name: Fenris, Wolf Union Rep
enemies.flavor: Negotiates with his teeth. His teeth have excellent benefits.

actions.name: Call a Strike
actions.desc: Binds one of your party members in picket lines.

actions.name: Howl of Solidarity
actions.desc: A big hit for the workers of the wild.

enemies.name: Gerald, Regional Slime Manager
enemies.flavor: Three ties. A name tag that says 'GERALD — ASK ME ABOUT QUOTAS'. The meadow's final boss.

actions.name: Quarterly Projections
actions.desc: Locks 5 orbs. The numbers must go up.

actions.name: Restructuring Slam
actions.desc: Massive damage. Your position has been made redundant.

actions.name: Mandatory Overtime
actions.desc: Reduces your move time by 2 seconds.

actions.name: Absorb Feedback
actions.desc: Gerald absorbs Nature damage this rotation. He hears you. He's not listening.

actions.name: Delegate Blame
actions.desc: Heals himself. It was YOUR fault somehow.
